summary: Argo Blockchain Plc filed a Form 6-K on September 3, 2026, announcing the departure of CEO Justin Nolan, effective August 30, 2026. A separation agreement provides a gross cash payment of $250,000, subject to standard revocation conditions. The Board initiated a search for a permanent CEO, focusing on AI infrastructure and data center expertise. Interim management will oversee operations under Board supervision. No strategic transaction is involved; the event is an abrupt leadership change, with what to watch being the timing and profile of the permanent CEO appointment.
